tasks.label: Install agentsplayground
tasks.command: if (-not (Get-Command agentsplayground -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host 'Installing agentsplayground...'; winget install agentsplayground --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements } else { Write-Host 'agentsplayground already installed' }

tasks.label: Install Python dependencies
tasks.command: $py = if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'py' } else { 'python' }; if (-not (Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}\.venv')) { & $py -3.13 -m venv '${workspaceFolder}\.venv' }; & '${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\pip.exe' install -r '${workspaceFolder}\requirements.txt' --no-input

tasks.label: Cleanup after debug
tasks.command: Get-Process agentsplayground -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8088 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Cleanup done'

tasks.label: Start playground watcher
tasks.command: Write-Host 'Playground watcher started'; $d=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(90); while((Get-Date)-lt$d){try{$t=New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient;$t.Connect('127.0.0.1',8088);$t.Close();break}catch{Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500}}; if((Get-Date)-lt$d){agentsplayground -e http://127.0.0.1:8088/api/messages -c emulator} else {Write-Warning 'Timeout: agent did not bind port 8088'}; exit 0
